incumbent_disposition.approval_state: retained for comparison, not approved as a probability model
permitted_use: Rank a bounded manual-review queue while the challenger remains rejected
Provide the fixed comparator for monitoring and future challenger evaluation
prohibited_use: Automatic approval, decline, pricing, or account-opening decisions
Interpretation of its score as a calibrated fraud probability
incumbent_disposition.review_cadence: Monthly after labels mature, and immediately after an escalation trigger
compensating_controls: Manual review is the only case-level action
Queue demand is checked against an explicit capacity ceiling
Calibration, stability, friction, and segment evidence remain visible to governance
Every challenger continues to face the fixed eleven-check promotion contract
escalation_triggers: Any use outside manual-review ranking or fixed comparison
Review demand exceeds the approved capacity ceiling
A calibration, stability, friction, or segment control breaches
Labels are too immature to support the reported performance period
exit_criteria: Replace only after a challenger passes every pre-agreed promotion check and governance approves use
Suspend ranking use if compensating controls cannot be operated
Retire when a production-validated strategy with accountable monitoring is approved
incumbent_disposition.limitation: These are designed operating responsibilities. They do not show that a real organization assigned or accepted them.

uncertainty.status: decision evidence, not a promotion gate
uncertainty.method: Fixed-seed paired row bootstrap of frozen month-7 queue membership. The challenger and incumbent use identical five-percent capacity and deterministic score ordering.
uncertainty.limitation: The interval measures sampling uncertainty conditional on one synthetic period and frozen rankings. Five synthetic time folds do not establish future production performance.

rule_dispositions.label: Eight or more recent emails share the birth-date signal
rule_dispositions.rationale: Reject as a queue override. It overwhelms capacity and displaces higher-ranked fraud.
rule_dispositions.policy_boundary: Non-binding reason code only. Never automatic decline or unbounded review.
rule_dispositions.limitation: One synthetic held-back period. Overlap is between application records, not shared identities or fraud rings.

rule_dispositions.label: Two or more recent emails share the device
rule_dispositions.rationale: Refer for controlled validation as a reason code only. It worsens the challenger queue and has no temporal validation.
rule_dispositions.policy_boundary: Non-binding reason code only. Never automatic decline or unbounded review.
rule_dispositions.limitation: One synthetic held-back period. Overlap is between application records, not shared identities or fraud rings.

rule_dispositions.label: Foreign request with weak name-and-email similarity
rule_dispositions.rationale: Reject as a queue override. It adds friction and reduces fraud caught at fixed capacity.
rule_dispositions.policy_boundary: Non-binding reason code only. Never automatic decline or unbounded review.
rule_dispositions.limitation: One synthetic held-back period. Overlap is between application records, not shared identities or fraud rings.

rule_dispositions.label: Selected-branch application concentration in the top 1%
rule_dispositions.rationale: Reject as a queue override. It adds friction, reduces fraud caught, and uses a final-period cutoff.
rule_dispositions.policy_boundary: Non-binding reason code only. Never automatic decline or unbounded review.
rule_dispositions.limitation: One synthetic held-back period. Overlap is between application records, not shared identities or fraud rings.

monitoring_controls.label: Calibration
monitoring_controls.threshold_basis: Pre-agreed gate: absolute calibration intercept at most 0.10
monitoring_controls.action: Prohibit probability interpretation and promotion; convene recalibration review
monitoring_controls.limitation: BAF has no outcome timestamps, so it cannot establish a production trigger.

monitoring_controls.label: Population stability
monitoring_controls.threshold_basis: Pre-agreed PSI warning at 0.10 and promotion block at 0.25
monitoring_controls.trigger: Any feature reaches the 0.25 promotion-block level
monitoring_controls.action: Keep rollout blocked; investigate seasonal versus durable shift before refitting
monitoring_controls.limitation: The static evidence has no continuing production population feed.

monitoring_controls.label: Investigator review yield
monitoring_controls.cadence: Weekly after a measured baseline exists
monitoring_controls.threshold_basis: Proposed: compare with the trailing four label-mature periods
monitoring_controls.trigger: Material fall against the governed trailing baseline
monitoring_controls.action: Investigate queue and rule composition; do not retrain automatically
monitoring_controls.limitation: No investigator handling or operating-yield baseline exists in BAF.

monitoring_controls.label: Review capacity
monitoring_controls.threshold_basis: Demand must fit the explicitly selected staffed ceiling
monitoring_controls.trigger: Any governance referral beyond the selected capacity
monitoring_controls.action: Stop expanding referrals and return the policy to governance; never auto decline
monitoring_controls.limitation: Capacity is an analyst input here, not observed staffing.

monitoring_controls.label: Customer friction
monitoring_controls.cadence: Monthly after labels and customer outcomes mature
monitoring_controls.threshold_basis: Proposed: governance-approved good-review and segment-friction bands
monitoring_controls.trigger: Good-review rate or segment gap leaves its approved band
monitoring_controls.action: Pause the policy change and review causes before resuming
monitoring_controls.evidence_source: Scenario insult rate and evaluation fairness evidence
monitoring_controls.limitation: Review is only a friction proxy; BAF has no abandonment or customer-value outcome.

monitoring_controls.label: Label maturity
monitoring_controls.threshold_basis: A measured maturity curve and event timestamps must precede outcome reporting
monitoring_controls.trigger: No measured maturity curve, timestamp lineage, or sufficiently mature vintage
monitoring_controls.action: Keep outcome metrics non-operational and require an append-only outcome feed
monitoring_controls.limitation: The current maturity curve is declared, not measured from BAF.

monitoring_controls.label: Segment performance
monitoring_controls.threshold_basis: Accepted gaps reopen if they widen by more than 0.05
monitoring_controls.trigger: An accepted disparity widens by more than 0.05 or acceptance lapses
monitoring_controls.action: Reopen governance review; never set a group-specific decision threshold
monitoring_controls.limitation: Aggregate synthetic evidence does not establish production treatment effects.

reopen_decision_when: A challenger passes all eleven unchanged promotion checks on untouched evidence
Production label maturity, investigator handling, capacity, and customer-friction feeds are verified
Every monitoring control has an accepted accountable owner and response process
Governance approves the bounded use after reviewing calibration, stability, and segment evidence
limitations: The BAF records are synthetic account-opening data, not observed production outcomes.
The source records no realized exposure, loss, review cost, customer value, or investigator handling data.
Nothing in this record authorizes an applicant decision or model rollout.
